summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of Phase 7a+ features: Plan y Uso page, sidebar updates, and rewritten Automation Policies page with CRUD functionality
passed_tests: Sidebar navigation: 'Plan y Uso' entry appears between Automation and Settings
Plan y Uso page (/plan) loads with all 4 required cards
Plan card displays: plan name (Starter), status badge (Trial), renewal date, view/upgrade buttons
Usage card displays: total calls (146), limit (10,000), usage percent (1.5%), progress bar, and 4 breakdown rows (inbox_ai, crm, content, automations)
Billing card displays: payment method, next billing date, manage button
Account card displays: user name (Test User), email (u1@test.com), workspace, switch/signout buttons
Account signout functionality: calls logout, clears localStorage token, redirects to /login
Automation Policies page (/automation) loads with proper page container
Automation tabs: Intent Policies and Escalation Rules tabs present and functional
Intent Policies tab: New policy button present
Escalation Rules tab: New rule button present and existing rules displayed with edit/delete/toggle controls
Authentication flow: Session token injection and AuthContext hydration working
Bilingual support: Interface switches between Spanish and English correctly
